```{r}

# read in data
pca <- read_table("sara_sapho_filtered_maf0.05_pruned.eigenvec", col_names = TRUE)
eigenval <- scan("sara_sapho_filtered_maf0.05_pruned.eigenval")
info <- read_table("sara_sapho_info.txt", col_names = TRUE)

# set names
names(pca)[1] <- "ind"
names(pca)[2:ncol(pca)] <- paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca)-1))

# add the species information
pca <- as_tibble(merge(pca, info, by="ind"))

## Plotting

# first convert to percentage variance explained
pve <- data.frame(PC = 1:length(eigenval), pve = eigenval/sum(eigenval)*100)

# make scree plot
ggplot(pve, aes(PC, pve)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ylab("Percentage variance explained") + theme_light()

# calculate the cumulative sum of the percentage variance explained
cumsum(pve$pve)

# plot pca
pca_a <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, col = pop)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
    coord_equal() + theme_light() +
    xlab(paste0("PC1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), "%)")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2 (", signif(pve$pve[2], 3), "%)"))

pca_a

# color by Species
pca_b <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, col = Species, label = pop)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_equal() + theme_light() +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", signif(pve$pve[2], 3), "%)")) + 
  geom_text()

pca_b

# color by Clade
pca_c <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, col = Clade, label=Species)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_equal() + theme_light() +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", signif(pve$pve[2], 3), "%)")) +
  geom_text_repel()

pca_c




```
